title: Google Workspace or Microsoft 365: Picking a Productivity Suite
excerpt: The two dominant productivity suites compared on real-time collaboration, fit with traditional Windows and Active Directory environments, and whether you need full desktop apps.
verdict: Google Workspace suits teams that work mainly in the browser and value effortless real-time collaboration. Microsoft 365 is the better fit for organisations that need full desktop Office applications and deep integration with existing Windows and Active Directory infrastructure.
